scripts.//test:proxy: The Worker under cloudflare-proxy/ needs its own vitest config (WebWorker lib, its own root), so the root config's include globs can never reach it — a positional path filter silently matches nothing. Chained into `test` so CI's single `npm test` covers it; a suite that never runs is not a suite.
scripts.//test:operator: Same reason as test:proxy: operator/ is outside the root vitest include globs. Chained into npm test.
scripts.test:smoke:import: npm run fetch-models && npm run build && node scripts/smoke-import.mjs
